name: drip-toast
title: Drip Toast
description: Toasts that drip out of the top of the screen — on an iPhone, straight out of the Dynamic Island — on a liquid strand that pinches off as the pill settles. A toast with a description or action lets a card drop out of the pill through a liquid neck, folds it back, and is sucked up into the edge when it leaves. mode="single" keeps one pill that gulps the old toast and drips out the next, so drip.promise() turns its spinner straight into the success or error card.
